# PermitIQ by Aureon - Full Documentation

PermitIQ by Aureon is an AI-powered NYC building code compliance checker designed for Registered Architects, Professional Engineers, Expediters, and Developers.

## System Capabilities
PermitIQ by Aureon uses advanced RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and multi-agent LLM analysis to parse architectural plans and compare them against 260+ NYC Building Code PDFs. It specifically cross-references data against the 2022/2026 NYC Construction Codes.

## Key Features
- **260+ NYC Building Code PDF Checks**: Scans for dimensional accuracy, required fire-ratings, egress widths, and more.
- **Instant Violation Detection**: Highlights areas of non-compliance before DOB submission to prevent plan objections.
- **PDF Compliance Report Generation**: Creates formal documentation that can be used for internal QA or client presentation.
- **Pre-permit Readiness Scoring**: Evaluates the overall health of a drawing set before uploading to DOB NOW.

Architects, Engineers, Developers, and Expediters working in the 5 boroughs of New York City (Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx, Staten Island).
